definition.simple: Temperature is a number that tells us exactly how hot or cold something is.
definition.academic: Temperature is a physical quantity that expresses quantitatively the perceptions of hotness and coldness, measured with a thermometer.

examples: Your body temperature is around 37 degrees Celsius.
Checking the weather app to see if it's 25°C outside.

common_misconceptions: Students think temperature is the same as heat. (Temperature is a measurement; Heat is the actual energy).
Thinking degrees Fahrenheit and Celsius are the same.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student 'If heat is the amount of water in a bucket, is temperature the water itself or the markings on the bucket?'
